scope: Every Ohio bingo listing whose schedule had ended, ended within 14 days or was last reviewed more than 30 days before November 23, 2026, plus the four listings with Attorney General enforcement records.
sources_allowed: Organizer pages, official venue or government pages, Attorney General enforcement documents and the Ohio Bingo Bugle.

findings.schedule_text: Licensed Type I sessions at 191 Barks Road W, Marion: Tuesdays 4:00 PM to 9:00 PM on 3/24/2026, 6/16/2026, 10/13/2026, 11/17/2026 and 12/15/2026 (per settlement agreement recital of the license)
findings.source_title: Ohio AG Settlement Agreement - Marion County Athletic Booster Association
findings.evidence: Settlement effective Oct 21, 2026 (Association signed 10/20, AG 10/21). Association agrees no one else will conduct or advertise its bingo and it will supply all operators, security and concessions itself.
findings.notes: No fine, suspension or surrender stated; license appears to continue under conditions. Para C.4: Association will not conduct bingo at any location that advertises bingo unless it belongs to another licensed charity; Cooper's Bowl (for-profit) advertised bingo, so whether the Dec 15 licensed session will be held at Cooper's Bowl is uncertain. The Dec 15 date is the licensed window, not an advertised event; the MCABA Facebook page could not be read (fetch refused). Odd: the enforcement page still lists the Nov 18, 2026 1:00 p.m. hearing under Upcoming Hearings despite the settlement; no cancellation order posted.
